title: CapabilityOperation
description: One fully resolved capability invocation inside an apply_capabilities job. By the time an operation exists here it has passed the agent-side argument validation, so distances are metres, angles are radians and colours are linear sRGB. 'arguments' is deliberately unconstrained at the contract level: each capability has its own argument shape, validated by studio_agent.proposal against a declarative table and again by the backend before any Blender process starts. 'label' is what the browser shows while the step runs, so it must be human-readable and free of internal identifiers. 'approval_token' is present only for a model-authored code step the user explicitly approved; it is a digest of that exact code, so an approval cannot be replayed for different code.

operation_index.description: Execution order within the plan, starting at 0. Also the per-step mutation identity component.

label.description: Progress text shown to the user, for example 'Creating the north wall'.

arguments.description: Canonical arguments for this capability. Metres, radians, linear sRGB.

approval_token.description: Present only when the user approved this exact model-authored code. Bound to a digest of the code, and re-derived by the backend, so approving one thing and running another is not possible.
